source_type: synthetic pollution series (illustrative urban Delhi-range levels; not real measurements)

units.aqi: Derived US-EPA-style AQI calculated from PM2.5 (NOT India CPCB NAQI; secondary context only)

instructions_to_replace_with_real_data: To replace with real physical sensor data, download hourly PM2.5 and PM10 from CPCB CCR (https://app.cpcbccr.com/AQI_India/) or OpenAQ and save to data/sample_pollution.csv with columns: timestamp, pm25, pm10, city, source, last_updated
